Staff & Senior Staff Data Platform Engineer - Slack
description_html: To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.      Job Category  Software Engineering    Job Details        About Salesforce     Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.    Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.        Agents are changing how people build software and analyze data. Slack’s data platform needs to support both agents that surface insights, and developer tools that use data to provide quantitative feedback in the product iteration process.  We’re looking for a Staff or Senior Staff engineer to help build out Agentic Analytics at Slack. You’ll collaborate on technical direction, build, and go from early prototypes through production. Your work could span many parts of the data stack: ingestion, infrastructure, semantic layers, and the interfaces that make data useful to humans and AI agents.  You’ll partner with engineers across Data Engineering, Data Science, product, core infrastructure, and developer experience to quickly iterate on high leverage problem spaces and ship pragmatic solutions.   You’ll help us :   Build data platform for agents. Design APIs, MCPs, and tools that let agents map data concepts to the right entities in the data warehouse.  Make data digestible. Improve our semantic layer so people and agents alike can navigate metric definitions, lineage, ownership, and reliability.  Make data on time (or provide signal when it’s not). Build ingestion and infrastructure for timely analytics, and experimentation. Evaluate tradeoffs between freshness, accuracy, reliability, and cost.  Ship tools that make data easy to analyze. Make it easy to draft accurate queries, do root cause analysis, and build visualizations.  Own the path to production. Drive architecture, implementation, rollout, and adoption.  Raise the engineering bar across teams by helping engineers make good design decisions, resolve technical dependencies, and grow through mentorship and leading by example.     How you work matters :   You’re a high velocity engineer. You decompose problem spaces into digestible chunks and constantly iterate.  You’re biased toward action. You love to prototype to test ideas and get feedback early, but are okay throwing away bad ideas.  You can quickly build context in unfamiliar areas. You can move between a pipeline, a service, or a developer tool, build enough context to contribute. You also know when to ask for help when it speeds things up.  You balance speed and judgment. You can get a prototype off the ground quickly, but also build a reliable and scalable production system      Minimum qualifications :   8+ years of experience building and operating a data platform  A track record of leading complex technical projects across teams as an individual contributor  Strong software engineering skills balanced with deep data expertise  Clear technical communication and the ability to build alignment with engineers, data scientists, analysts, and product partners  Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python, Go, Java, or similar      Bonus points for :   Experience building infrastructure or tools for AI agents  Experience with semantic layers, metrics platforms, data catalogs, or lineage. These might include familiarity with tools like Airflow, dbt, Databricks, sqlmesh, Datahub, Superset or Snowflake  Expertise in SQL & Python to build data pipelines  Experience building APIs, SDKs, or self-service platforms that other engineers use.  Practical experience using AI development tools to accelerate implementation while maintaining engineering quality.     Technologies We Use:  Data: Trino, Spark, Pinot, Hive, Airflow, Iceberg, Spark, Datahub, Kafka  Storage: S3  Infrastructure: Terraform, AWS  Languages: Python, Go, SQL, Scala, Typescript           Unleash Your Potential    When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and     be your best  , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can     do your best  . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description_html: Job Requisition ID #                      26WD99276      Position Overview   Want to help make a better world? As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer at Autodesk, you can help us build and operate reliable, secure, and scalable cloud services for Autodesk GovCloud products.    As part of a new SRE team supporting Autodesk  GovCloud , you will have a unique opportunity to help shape how Autodesk deploys, runs, and improves production services in restricted cloud environments. This is a foundational role where you will help establish the operating model, reliability practices, automation, and engineering standards needed to support critical customer-facing services.    You will combine software engineering and production operations to deploy, run, monitor, improve, and automate Autodesk services in GovCloud. You will partner closely with product engineering, security, compliance, platform, and infrastructure teams to ensure services are reliable, scalable, secure, and ready for production.    The ideal candidate has deep experience operating production systems at scale, an automation-first mindset, and the ability to improve reliability through engineering practices such as SLOs/SLIs, production readiness, incident management, observability, resilience testing, and toil reduction. Success in this role requires strong technical judgment, a customer-focused mindset, and a passion for using software engineering to solve operational problems at scale.      In accordance with GovCloud Cloud Service Provider Security Requirements, this role must be performed by U.S. Citizens. Employment is contingent upon meeting all applicable government security and eligibility requirements, including necessary background investigations and government issued security clearances. description_html: Excited to grow your career?    We value our talented employees, and whenever possible strive to help one of our associates grow professionally before recruiting new talent to our open positions. If you think the open position you see is right for you, we encourage you to apply!  Our people make all the difference in our success.       Applications Development Technology Lead Analyst – Senior Cloud & Risk Platform Engineer   Are you passionate about engineering high-throughput, cloud-native distributed systems that power global financial decisioning? Are you an innovative builder who embraces modern AI-augmented software engineering—leveraging intelligent tools like  GitHub Copilot, Claude, and Devin  to accelerate the SDLC and solve complex engineering challenges faster?  The  Applications Development Technology Lead Analyst  is a senior-level position responsible for architecting and building robust, resilient, ultra-low latency, and high-performance services across our next-generation Cloud stack. In this role, you will lead the core systems analysis, design, and implementation of mission-critical services spanning  Credit Risk  and  Market Risk  platforms, turning quantitative models and complex risk analytics into scalable, real-time cloud microservices.   Responsibilities:     Architect & Build Cloud-Native Services:  Lead the design, development, and deployment of resilient, event-driven microservices and high-throughput computing pipelines on modern cloud infrastructure (Containers, Kubernetes, Microservices).   Power Enterprise Risk Engines:  Partner closely with Risk Quantitative Analysts, Risk Managers, and Enterprise Architecture teams to model, calculate, and stream real-time analytics across  Credit Risk  (PFE, Exposure, Counterparty Risk, Limits) and  Market Risk  (VaR, Stress Testing, Sensitivity Analysis).   Champion AI-Augmented Engineering:  Pioneer the adoption of modern AI engineering toolsets (e.g.,  GitHub Copilot, Claude, Devin ) across the engineering lifecycle—from rapid prototyping and boilerplate reduction to automated unit/integration test synthesis, complex refactoring, and AI-driven code reviews.   Lead System Resiliency & Scalability:  Resolve complex architectural bottlenecks through in-depth evaluation of distributed systems, multi-threading, concurrency models, memory management, and enterprise data flows.   Define Engineering Excellence:  Establish and champion standards for clean code, SOLID principles, automated CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration, and comprehensive telemetry/observability.   Technical Mentorship & Thought Leadership:  Serve as a technical advisor and coach to mid-level engineers and analysts, conducting design reviews, fostering a culture of continuous learning, and accelerating delivery velocity.   Risk & Controls Governance:  Appropriately assess risk when business and technical decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients, and assets by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules, and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct, and business practices, and escalating, managing, and reporting control issues with transparency.    Qualifications:     6–10 years  of progressive experience in software engineering, distributed systems development, or applications architecture.   Core Java & Modern Stack Mastery:  Deep expertise in Java (Java 17/21+), J2EE, Spring Boot, reactive frameworks, advanced multi-threading, asynchronous I/O, low-latency processing, and memory optimization.   Risk Domain Expertise:  Strong working knowledge of  Credit Risk  and/or  Market Risk  concepts (e.g., Counterparty Credit Risk, Stress Testing, Exposure Calculations, Value at Risk / VaR, Sensitivities, Scenarios).   Cloud & Distributed Computing:  Hands-on experience architecting microservices on cloud platforms, with solid containerization and orchestration expertise ( Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, OpenShift ).   AI Tooling & Modern Dev Acceleration:  Demonstrated proficiency and enthusiasm for integrating AI coding assistants and agentic engineering tools ( GitHub Copilot, Claude, Devin, ChatGPT/LLM APIs ) to elevate team velocity, code quality, and automated debugging.   High-Throughput Messaging & Event Streaming:  Experience with distributed messaging backbones and streaming platforms such as  Apache Kafka , Pulsar, or RabbitMQ.   API & Data Architecture:  Strong experience designing robust RESTful APIs, gRPC services, and working with relational databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL, MS SQL) and distributed caches/NoSQL platforms (Redis, Hazelcast, Cassandra, MongoDB).   Quality & Test Automation:  Proven background with testing frameworks (JUnit 5, Mockito, Cucumber, Testcontainers) and performance benchmarking (JMeter, Gatling).   CI/CD & DevOps:  Hands-on familiarity with modern CI/CD automation pipelines (Git, Tekton, Harness, Jenkins), static analysis (SonarQube), and container security scanning.   Leadership & Communication:  Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and collaborative skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical and risk concepts clearly to cross-functional stakeholders. title: Senior Solutions Architect, AI and HPC Infrastructure
description_html: NVIDIA is seeking an outstanding AI Solutions Architect to assist and support energy-sector customers — power generation, oil & gas, transmission and distribution / grid, and renewables — as they build and operate AI infrastructure on NVIDIA's accelerated computing platforms. At NVIDIA, our solutions architects work across product, engineering, sales, developer relations, business development, and partner teams to help customers design, deploy, and optimize AI infrastructure for the energy industry. This role will focus on helping energy accounts from datacenter to the edge adopt NVIDIA accelerated infrastructure for training, fine-tuning, inference, retrieval, and agentic AI and HPC workloads. This is an excellent opportunity to work in an interdisciplinary team at NVIDIA! You will serve as a technical advisor for accelerated systems architecture, GPU and networking systems, cluster design, orchestration, validation, and production deployment for AI data centers and edge environments serving energy customers.     We need a curious, collaborative, and creative individual to advance these opportunities across AI infrastructure, industrial digital twins, and accelerated computing for the energy sector, and to become a trusted technical advisor bridging our industry, infrastructure, and partner teams. Engaging with internal developers, researchers, data scientists, and senior leaders is a core part of the role and offers exposure to a wide range of partners and challenges.      What you'll be doing:    Partner with energy-sector customers, ISVs, and account teams on discovery, architecture reviews, technical deep dives, POCs, benchmarks, demos, and production deployment guidance for AI infrastructure.  Advise on the design, build-out, and optimization of accelerated AI infrastructure for energy customers, including large-scale GPU clusters, AI factories, and edge deployments.  Support infrastructure design across compute, networking, storage, containers, observability, security, power, and data center operations for energy-sector AI workloads.  Drive adoption of systems monitoring, telemetry, and management tools to improve cluster utilization, reliability, performance, and workload insight.  Document what you learn and teach others — through targeted samples, whitepapers, blogs, and working through hard problems with customers.  Build repeatable reference architectures, deployment guides, sizing guidance, benchmark reports, technical playbooks, demos, and whitepapers for energy-sector AI infrastructure.  Strategically partner with flagship customers and industry-specific solution partners targeting our computing platform.  Collaborate primarily through virtual tools, and be empowered to find the best way to make our partners and customers successful. Travel up to 20% for customer meetings may be required.       What we need to see:    BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Physics, other Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).  8+ years of hands-on experience in AI infrastructure, accelerated computing, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, high-performance computing, or machine learning platforms, with strong experience designing, deploying, and operating accelerated computing infrastructure at scale.  In-depth knowledge of AI cluster orchestration, scheduling, automation, and CI/CD deployment pipelines, and understanding of data center networking technologies such as InfiniBand, Ethernet, RDMA, network configuration, and performance tuning.  Familiarity with infrastructure requirements for AI workloads, including distributed training, inference serving, model deployment, storage performance, and cluster reliability.  Working knowledge of one or more energy sectors (power generation, oil & gas, transmission and distribution / grid, or renewables) and their operational and IT environments.  Excellent presentation, communication, problem-solving, documentation, and collaboration skills.  Strong problem structuring and the self-direction to drive ambiguous, multi-stakeholder projects to results.       Ways to stand out from the crowd:    Experience architecting AI factories, large GPU clusters, multi-node training environments, or production inference platforms.  Experience deploying LLM training, fine-tuning, RAG, and inference workflows on large-scale AI infrastructure.  Experience evaluating cluster performance using benchmarks such as MLPerf, HPL, or workload-specific performance tests.  Applications and systems-level knowledge of OpenMPI, NCCL, distributed training frameworks, and GPU communication patterns.  Comfortable with modern application-deployment practices such as Docker/Containers and Kubernetes.        NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!     Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD for Level 4, and 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD for Level 5.           You will also be eligible for equity and  benefits .           Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 24, 2026.   This posting is for an existing vacancy.   NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.   NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Forward Deployed Engineering
description_html: Do you want to help the world build custom AI at scale? We’re hiring a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead the technical strategy and execution of NVIDIA’s Forward Deployed Engineering engagements across NVIDIA Nemotron and NVIDIA Cosmos. This role turns each engagement into a customer success story, taking domain-specific AI from first idea to production. It combines a solution architect’s technical depth with engagement strategy and ecosystem alignment.   Our FDE engagements run through the partner ecosystem, so each one involves three parties: NVIDIA, the partner, and the end customer. This leader is the key interface for all three, keeping them aligned from the first use-case conversation through model and harness customization to production. It’s a great fit for someone with strong technical depth, ecosystem experience, and a habit of using AI agents and tools to automate program work.  Are you a program leader who delivers results, not just status updates? We’d love to meet you!    What you’ll be doing:    This role sets the technical direction for each FDE engagement and serves as the main point of contact for NVIDIA, the partner, and the end customer. It turns each use case into a clear plan with scope, milestones, and success criteria, and keeps all three parties aligned from first conversation to production. Collaboration is central: build trust and shared goals across NVIDIA, partners, and customers.  We run programs with agents. Automate everything that can be automated, including SOWs, status updates, meeting synthesis, and risk flags, so the team’s time goes to decisions and relationships. Build and share agent workflows, and review their output with good judgment.  The work is technical. Work with FDEs and partner engineers to understand the use case, data, evaluation approach, and post-training and deployment path well enough to scope engagements and spot risks early. Shape the data and program strategy, make the technical decisions that drive outcomes, and use agents to surface issues sooner.  Build the way we deliver- Define the processes and artifacts that make every engagement repeatable, and turn what works into playbooks, templates, and reusable agent workflows. Drive each engagement through delivery, work with legal and partner teams on agreements, data sharing, and compute access, and clear blockers early.  Look across partners, use cases, open model builders, and cloud providers to see where NVIDIA adds the most value and spot repeating patterns. Work hand in hand with FDEs, sales, partner, and solutions teams, keep NVIDIA and partner priorities aligned, report progress to leadership, and bring the patterns and insights from the field back to Product, Engineering, and Research.     What we need to see:    Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.  6+ years in technical program management, solutions architecture, forward deployed engineering, or technical customer delivery, including leading complex multi-party programs from proof of concept to production.  Working knowledge of the LLM post-training lifecycle (data, evaluation, fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, deployment), with enough technical depth to engage credibly with ML engineers. Practical comfort with Python and cloud and GPU infrastructure.  Strong hands-on experience using AI agents and agentic workflows to run programs, including planning, tracking, and reporting, and the judgment to validate their output.  Experience working across the open model, post-training and harness, and cloud provider ecosystems, including multi-company engagements with executives.
